facts.description:
NAVA
The name "Nava" is chosen for its associations with newness, freshness, beauty, and goodness in various ancient languages. This name aligns with the concept of starting a new chapter, as in moving into a new home. The letters in "Nava" also represent Nature, Allure, Vibrancy, and Aspiration, reflecting the development's core values of Nature,
Nurture, and Nourish — all beginning with the letter N. Additionally, the success of Nava Park in Indonesia, a project by Hongkong Land, of which MCL Land is a wholly-owned subsidiary, along with Sinarmas Land, supports the choice of this name and emphasises a sense of continuity and both the developers’ commitment to excellence.
GROVE
The term "Grove" pays homage to the area's history, specifically its roots in Pine Grove.
Nestled within a verdant green belt, Nava Grove offers a harmonious relationship between people and nature. The property features lush landscapes, naturalistic pools, and a range of wellness-inspired amenities designed to promote health and vitality. It is conceptualised as a sanctuary with ample space and opportunities for families to thrive and flourish together, a vision encapsulated in the name Nava Grove.
